description: This file defines a generic object pool class 'ObjectPool<T>' that manages reusable resources of type T, which must inherit from PooledResource<T>. It uses a concurrent stack to store available objects, supports monitoring and periodic reporting, and provides methods for allocating and freeing resources.

classes.name: ObjectPool<T>
classes.description: A thread-safe generic object pool that manages reusable resources, with support for monitoring and statistics reporting.

methods.name: ObjectPool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object pool with a factory function, optional monitor, and optional monitoring interval.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a resource from the pool, creating a new one if none are available.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Returns a resource to the pool for future reuse.
